Package com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.common

Class ListingDetailDialog

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.common.ListingDetailDialog
public final class ListingDetailDialog extends Object
A small read-only preview of one listing. It is used from screens that only link to a listing (deal history, reviews, notifications) and do not render the full listing details themselves, so a link can show the item without navigating away from the current screen.
